name: Spirit of War
body:
School conjuration; Level cleric 2, paladin 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 minute

Calling upon Ares, you are imbued with the essence of war as divine power courses through your veins.

While under the effects of this spell, you gain the following benefits:

Your speed increases by 10 feet.
You gain a +2 bonus to your AC and Reflex saves as your reflexes become heightened.
You gain 1 temporary hit point per level.
